title: 新加坡推进人形机器人警务合作
titleEn: Singapore to deploy humanoid robots with police by 2028
summary: 新加坡计划于2028年部署人形机器人与警务团队合作,用于调查爆炸现场和处理危险物品。
summaryEn: Singapore will deploy humanoid robots to assist Home Team officers by 2028, handling tasks like blast scene investigations and hazardous material handling.
speaker: Noah Kong
